image_description: A high-angle view of an ornate, semi-circular altar in a Gothic cathedral. The altar features a reddish-brown marble base with gold veining, draped with a white lace cloth. On top sit floral arrangements (pink/red roses), candles, and a central diamond-shaped reliquary or monstrance. The background shows the nave of the church with tall arched windows, stone columns, and dim ambient lighting.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The lace pattern is extremely dense and uniform, lacking the subtle irregularities of real fabric. It borders on looking like a generated texture map rather than physical threads, though it is not outright gibberish.

The central object lacks clear structural logic. The frame seems to merge with the glass/crystal elements without visible joints or mounting points. It appears slightly 'melted' or fused, typical of AI struggling with complex transparent/refractive objects.
The vertical lines of the distant columns show slight waviness and inconsistency in perspective convergence, suggesting minor geometric instability in the background generation.
